top_candidates.original_title: Securing a DoD contractor: Finding a multi-tenant authorization vulnerability
top_candidates.summary: An analysis of a critical authorization flaw in a DoD contractor’s environment reveals that the shift toward multi-tenant architectures often trades fundamental isolation for operational convenience. top_candidates.generated_headline: Canary traps and the hardening of the Canadian voter roll
